cli.failure_details.required_group: one of the arguments {names} is required
cli.failure_details.not_seconds: {value} is not a number of seconds
cli.failure_details.finite_seconds: must be a finite number of seconds
cli.failure_details.exec_two:
exec takes ONE positional prompt, got {count} positionals: {received}.
The first positional is the prompt, not a title. To name the run, pass the title via --name:
  {command}
(--workstream is a flag — it publishes the run and takes no value.)
cli.failure_details.exec_many:
exec takes ONE positional prompt, got {count} positionals: {received}.
The first positional is the prompt, not a title: pass the title via --name, and quote the prompt as the ONE positional — the extra positionals are not consumed.
(--workstream is a flag — it publishes the run and takes no value.)
